Answer: A
Reason: The initial chest X-ray shows correct port-a-cath placement, while the subsequent image demonstrates a grade 1 pinch-off sign (mild narrowing between the clavicle and first rib). The fluoroscopy images confirm catheter fragmentation with embolization to the pulmonary artery (asterisk) and successful percutaneous retrieval using a snare device (image b), which is the standard minimally invasive management for this complication.
